title: Grateful Dead Live at San Antonio Civic Auditorium on 1971-11-12
lineage: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a slightly quiet, hiss‑y mix but an electrifying 1971 show highlighted by a monster Other One → Big Railroad Blues and tight group playing.
ai_review.review: The performance captures the raw energy of late‑71 Dead, with the band firing on all cylinders – Jerry’s voice is strong, Phil’s bass is front‑and‑center, and Keith’s fresh piano adds sparkle.  The soundboard source is generally well balanced though a few listeners note reduced volume, compression and occasional hiss.  Standout moments include the soaring Other One into Big Railroad Blues, a punchy Jack Straw, Black Peter and an exuberant Truckin' opener.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (10 out of 12) are 4‑5 stars praising the musical performance; only one mentions recording problems and another gives a middling 3‑star rating for compression issues.  Show quality is rated high, recording quality good but not perfect, yielding an overall 4.2‑star score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is generally well balanced with piano, drums and bass proportioned correctly; several reviewers note the show sounds a bit quiet/compressed and has some hiss, but overall it is listenable and captures the band clearly.

standout_songs: The Other One > Big Railroad Blues
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set that builds into a powerful second half; the show opens with Truckin', moves through tight group numbers, and climaxes with an extended Other One jam leading into Big Railroad Blues.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Most reviewers say his voice is great all night; one comment complains it sounds unusually quiet/compressed.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass lines are praised as “snappy” and “front‑and‑center,” with Phil’s lead bass work highlighted throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals are generally praised, noting only a single flub on Jack Straw; his rhythm guitar anchors the group.
band_member_comments.Keys: New keyboardist Keith is singled out for an up‑front piano sound that adds sparkle and uniqueness to the performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill Kreutzmann) receives compliments for a snappy, driving beat that locks tightly with Phil’s bass.
